node.statement: For U_0,c,a from nodes 1.3.1-1.3.2, scalar equivariance sigma(zU)=conj(z)*sigma(U) from node 1.1 yields sigma(a*U_0)=conj(a)*c*U_0 and sigma(-a*U_0)=-conj(a)*c*U_0. Since a is in U(1), conj(a)*a=1; with c=a^2 this gives conj(a)*c=a. Therefore sigma(a*U_0)=a*U_0 and sigma(-a*U_0)=-a*U_0, proving all assertions of node 1.3.
